lines.say: Does stretching before lifting stop injuries?
Holding long stretches before training is a classic warm-up. But big reviews found it doesn't really prevent injuries.
Long static holds, over a minute per muscle, can even make you a little weaker for a short time.
What does help: a real warm-up. A few minutes of light movement, then lighter sets of your first exercise.
And strength training itself cut sports injuries to about a third in one big review.
Verdict: mostly myth. Stretch if you need the mobility. Just keep the holds short before lifting, or stretch after.
Warm up with movement, not by lying on the floor.
